sub_sections.title: Bug Bomb
sub_sections.description_text:
[b]Mission:[/b] Data Hive - Rally Point Foxtrot (6)
[b]Difficulty:[/b] Heroic or higher.

[b]Challenge:[/b] Defeat (250) Drones in Halo 3: ODST on Heroic or harder.

[b]Rewards:[/b] 35,000 XP and Bug Splattered Buck Helmet On Firefight skin.

[i][b]Note: It may be more efficient to farm the first room with the 8 Drones and just reload the checkpoint over and over again.[/b][/i]
